# Init a project

> Sets up a project for Gradatim: git, and an AGENTS.md that holds the idea, who works on it and the cycle; in a project in progress, a quick start to its first task. Use when the user asks for Gradatim's init step, to start a project from an idea with Gradatim, or to set up Gradatim in this folder.

| | |
|---|---|
| Skill | `init-project`, [its file](../../skills/init-project/SKILL.md) |
| Step | 1 of 14: init |
| Runs | Once, first |
| Next | research |
| Call it | `/gradatim:init-project` on Claude Code; [the other hosts](install.md#calling-a-skill) |

## When to use it

- The user has an idea and wants to start a project with Gradatim, or wants Gradatim set up in this folder.
- Not for a folder that already holds a Gradatim project: that is [`method`](method.md), which tells where it stands. A quick start that stopped is the one exception, as "Stop" says.
- Not for a changed idea or direction: that is [`decide-direction`](decide-direction.md).

## What it reads and writes

| Document | Path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Agent file | `AGENTS.md` | reads, creates, changes |

It also runs `git init` where no repository holds the folder. It reads the folder's other files, and changes none of them. Its quick start also writes, on their steps' behalf, what [the quick start](../../skills/method/references/quick-start.md)'s table lists.

<!-- end of the generated block -->

## Good to know

- **In a folder that already has code,** init keeps every file, and asks whether to start from what is there or by the full cycle. From what is there, one read of the code and one agreement reach the sprint's first task, and the next step is design task.
- **Where the project's own files hold Gradatim's paths,** such as a `docs/sprints/` of its own, Gradatim's documents go in `docs/gradatim/`, which one line in `AGENTS.md` names. The project's own files and rules stay as they are.
- **By the full cycle,** research's first topic is what the code already does: it reads the code once, into a report that the later steps read in place of the code.
- **Run again where a quick start stopped,** init offers to go on from its drafts, or to start `method`.
